Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Finexa requested a follow-up technical deep-dive focused on pool sizing, autoscale behavior, and tenant isolation strategies before procurement signs off. Proposed objective: leave with a concrete capacity playbook (initial slot counts, autoscale policies, and an isolation recommendation).

- Quick context (5m)
- Workload profile & SLO tradeoffs (10m)
- Pool sizing and autoscale knobs (10m)
- Isolation/tenant mapping and fallback policy (10m)
- Actions & ownership (5m)

Suggested times (PST):
- Tue 2027-04-06 09:30–10:15
- Tue 2027-04-06 13:00–13:45
- Wed 2027-04-07 08:00–08:45
